sections.text: CP is Delhi's most walkable district. The inner and outer circles are ringed with restaurants, cafés, bookshops and shopping arcades, and the Rajiv Chowk metro interchange connects to every corner of the city without needing a cab. For first-time visitors, NRIs on short trips and business travellers with meetings in Barakhamba or Central Secretariat, CP is the most convenient base in Delhi.
